incident.user_observation: The account-panel Switch button was disabled.
incident.root_cause: The browser panel treated the historical auth_expired state as permanently disabled even after its bounded cooldown had elapsed, while scheduler readiness already considered the account recovery-eligible.

first_failure_test.expected_failure: An auth_expired account remained disabled at its exact cooldown boundary.

implementation.recovery_boundary: cooldown_until is non-null and less than or equal to the injected panel clock

r93_intermediate_deployment.reason: Cross-platform gzip bytes differed and an early multi-check shell guard could be masked by a later successful condition.

browser_verification.reason: The browser-control channel timed out while extracting the large application DOM after reload.

safety.manual_switch_scope: A later new backend session only

residual_risks: An elapsed auth cooldown permits only a bounded recovery switch. It does not prove that the credential is currently accepted; the next separate new request may classify it auth_expired again and select another eligible account before semantic output.

The deployed module and live panel model prove that the button is enabled, but browser-control DOM extraction did not complete. The user browser may require one hard refresh to discard the prior index document.
